recap.text: Donut hisses with rage at the piles of torches that keep appearing in front of her, since most of her haul is the same old crap. A Silver Adventurer box, her reward for finally dealing melee damage, holds a bracelet that adds two to her dexterity, bringing it to twelve. When she equips it, it wraps snugly round her front leg. A Silver Survivor's Box hands her a dozen Heal scrolls.

Carl has pried a wooden anklet off a dead tree woman and wants to see whether the game will let Donut wear it. He thinks it will, since she already has one bracelet wrapped round her forward leg, though he can barely see it through all the fur. Donut looks at the anklet with distaste and asks, "Wood?

Donut's gold box pops out a sparkling silver bracelet with little purple gems, and she puts it on her left foreleg at once. The obsidian bracelet that lets her cast Fireball moves to her right foreleg. The fallen oak anklet stays on one back leg and her plus-two dexterity bracelet on the other, so with a bracelet on all four legs she cannot add any more.

beats.headline: Finally, melee damage

One exception is a bracelet from a Silver Adventurer box she received for finally dealing melee damage. It adds two to her dexterity, bringing it to twelve, and when she equips it, it wraps snugly round her front leg. A Silver Survivor's Box gives her a dozen Heal scrolls as well.
beats.gist: Donut's first bracelet, from a Silver Adventurer box, adds two dexterity, raising it to twelve.

beats.headline: Room for an anklet

beats.gist: Carl wants Donut to wear a wooden anklet from a dead tree woman, but Donut dislikes the wood.

beats.headline: All four legs
beats.text: Donut's gold box pops out a sparkling silver bracelet with little purple gems, and she equips it at once. The obsidian bracelet that lets her cast Fireball moves to her right foreleg and the new one goes on the left. The fallen oak anklet stays tucked on one back leg and her plus-two dexterity bracelet on the other. With bracelets on all four legs, she can't add any more. Doesn't it look divine?
beats.gist: Donut equips a sparkling silver bracelet with purple gems on her left foreleg, filling all four legs.
